summary: A Flutter app in Dart for iPhone and Android, with view models, repositories, go_router and a test that runs on the iOS simulator.
description: Start a Flutter app for iOS and Android from one Dart codebase. The recipe follows the layers in Flutter's architecture guide: screens read ChangeNotifier view models, view models call repositories, and repositories decode data from services behind an interface, starting with an in-memory fake. go_router handles navigation and the not-found page, settings come from --dart-define values with validated defaults, and one error type turns every failure into a message the screen shows with a retry. Unit and widget tests run without a device, and an integration test runs the app on an iPhone simulator. The home screen's greeting is the example payload; your screens, real services and store setup come next.
seoDescription: A Flutter starter for iOS and Android with ChangeNotifier view models, repositories, go_router, strict analysis and tests on the iOS simulator.

projectExamples.title: Conference schedule app
projectExamples.description: An iPhone and Android app for attendees that loads the session list from the organizer's feed, shows each talk's room and time, and offers a retry when the network drops.

projectExamples.title: Transit departures board
projectExamples.description: A phone app that shows the next departures for a stop the rider picks, loaded from a public transit feed, on iOS and Android.

plain.whatItIs: A starter phone app for iPhone and Android written once in Dart with Flutter, Google's toolkit that draws the same screens on both.
